k8sgpt

A rule-based Kubernetes scanner with model-written explanations.

WHAT IT IS

A CNCF Sandbox project that runs analyzers over cluster resources to find problems, then uses a model to explain them in plain language. CLI and operator modes.

WHAT SETS IT APART

Narrower and more predictable than HolmesGPT: Kubernetes only, analyzers first, model second. Many teams run it as a first-pass scanner.

WHERE WE STAND

Watch, or use as a cheap first pass alongside HolmesGPT.

Project documentation; 2026 comparisons (vendor-affiliated, directional)

WATCH

k8sgpt: A rule-based Kubernetes scanner with model-written explanations. Where we stand: Watch, or use as a cheap first pass alongside HolmesGPT. Good for 'what's wrong in this cluster right now', less good for 'why did this alert fire'.
